mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT a.id as assignment_id, GROUP_CONCAT(asub.id ORDER BY asub.id) as submission_ids, asub.session_id, asub.subject_type, asub.subject_id,
-- Student/Group info CASE WHEN asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' THEN su.user_name WHEN asub.subject_type = 'GROUP' THEN sg.group_name ELSE 'Unknown' END as entity_name,
-- Group member count for GROUP assessments CASE WHEN asub.subject_type = 'GROUP' THEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_student_group sgm WHERE sgm.group_id = asub.subject_id ) ELSE NULL END as group_member_count,
-- Session timing info ss.start_at as session_start_at, ss.end_at as session_end_at,
-- Venue info ss.venue_id as session_venue_id, v.room_name as venue_name,
-- Release status derived from assessment_submission.release_status CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN asub.release_status = 'RELEASED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'RELEASED' ELSE 'NOT_RELEASED' END as release_status,
-- Final score override info asub.final_score_override as final_score_override_pct, asub.override_reason as final_score_override_reason, asub.override_at as final_score_override_at, asub.override_by_user_id as final_score_override_by
FROM assignment a JOIN assessment_submission asub ON a.id = asub.assignment_id LEFT JOIN slot_sessions ss ON asub.session_id = ss.session_id LEFT JOIN venue v ON ss.venue_id = v.id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND asub.subject_id = su.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_group sg ON asub.subject_type = 'GROUP' AND asub.subject_id = sg.group_id
WHERE a.id = #{assignmentId}
AND asub.session_id = #{sessionId}
AND asub.release_status = 'RELEASED'
AND (asub.release_status != 'RELEASED' OR asub.release_status IS NULL)
AND ( (asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND ( su.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchQuery}, '%') OR asub.subject_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchQuery}, '%') )) OR (asub.subject_type = 'GROUP' AND ( sg.group_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchQuery}, '%') OR asub.subject_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchQuery}, '%') )) )
GROUP BY a.id, asub.session_id, asub.subject_type, asub.subject_id, entity_name, group_member_count, asub.final_score_override, asub.override_reason, asub.override_at, asub.override_by_user_id, ss.start_at, ss.end_at, ss.venue_id, v.room_name ORDER BY entity_name
LIMIT #{limit}
OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT a.id as assignment_id, a.name as assignment_name, a.rubric_meta_info, a.rubrics_info,
asub.session_id, asub.subject_type, asub.subject_id, asub.id as submission_id, asub.status as status, asub.release_status as release_status,
-- Session timing info ss.start_at as session_start_at, ss.end_at as session_end_at,
-- Venue info ss.venue_id as session_venue_id, v.room_name as venue_name,
-- Student/Group info CASE WHEN asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' THEN su.user_name WHEN asub.subject_type = 'GROUP' THEN sg.group_name ELSE 'Unknown' END as entity_name,
CASE WHEN asub.subject_type = 'GROUP' THEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_student_group sgm WHERE sgm.group_id = asub.subject_id ) ELSE NULL END as group_member_count,
-- Final score override info asub.final_score_override as final_score_override_pct, asub.override_reason as final_score_override_reason, asub.override_at as final_score_override_at, asub.override_by_user_id as final_score_override_by,
-- Consolidated feedback from all examiners ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( CASE WHEN asub_all.overall_feedback IS NOT NULL AND asub_all.overall_feedback != '' THEN CONCAT('Examiner ', u.user_name, ': ', asub_all.overall_feedback) ELSE NULL END SEPARATOR '\n\n' ) FROM assessment_submission asub_all LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON asub_all.examiner_id = u.user_id WHERE asub_all.assignment_id = asub.assignment_id AND asub_all.subject_type = asub.subject_type AND asub_all.subject_id = asub.subject_id AND asub_all.status = 'SUBMITTED' AND asub_all.overall_feedback IS NOT NULL AND asub_all.overall_feedback != '' ) as consolidated_feedback,
-- Admin notes (get from any submission, they should be consistent) asub.admin_note as admin_notes
FROM assignment a JOIN assessment_submission asub ON a.id = asub.assignment_id LEFT JOIN slot_sessions ss ON asub.session_id = ss.session_id LEFT JOIN venue v ON ss.venue_id = v.id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND asub.subject_id = su.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_group sg ON asub.subject_type = 'GROUP' AND asub.subject_id = sg.group_id
WHERE asub.id = #{submissionId} LIMIT 1

SELECT asub.id as submission_id, asub.examiner_id, asub.status as assessment_status, asub.submitted_at, asub.total_score, asub.overall_feedback, asub.admin_note as notes, asub.rubric_meta_snapshot, asub.rubrics_info_snapshot, asub.scores_json,
-- Examiner info u.user_name as examiner_name
FROM assessment_submission asub JOIN sys_user u ON asub.examiner_id = u.user_id
WHERE asub.assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND asub.session_id = #{sessionId} AND asub.subject_type = #{subjectType} AND asub.subject_id = #{subjectId}
ORDER BY asub.examiner_id

SELECT asub.id as submission_id, asub.examiner_id, asub.status as assessment_status, asub.submitted_at, asub.total_score, asub.overall_feedback, asub.admin_note as notes, asub.rubric_meta_snapshot, asub.rubrics_info_snapshot, asub.scores_json,
-- Examiner info u.user_name as examiner_name
FROM assessment_submission asub JOIN sys_user u ON asub.examiner_id = u.user_id
WHERE asub.id = #{submissionId} AND asub.examiner_id = #{examinerId}
mapper.update: UPDATE assignment SET results_released = CASE WHEN #{releaseStatus} = 'RELEASED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, results_released_at = CASE WHEN #{releaseStatus} = 'RELEASED' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{assignmentId}
UPDATE assignment SET is_released = #{released}, released_at = CASE WHEN #{released} = TRUE THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{assignmentId}

UPDATE assessment_submission SET final_score_override = #{finalScore}, override_reason = #{reason}, override_by_user_id = #{userId}, override_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND session_id = #{sessionId} AND ( -- For individual assessments, update the specific student's submissions (subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND subject_id = #{subjectId} AND #{subjectType} = 'INDIVIDUAL') OR -- For group assessments, update all submissions for group members (subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND #{subjectType} = 'GROUP' AND subject_id IN ( SELECT sg.user_id FROM sys_student_group sg WHERE sg.group_id = #{subjectId} )) OR -- Also update the group-level submission if it exists (subject_type = 'GROUP' AND subject_id = #{subjectId} AND #{subjectType} = 'GROUP') )

UPDATE assessment_submission a1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT assignment_id, subject_id, subject_type FROM assessment_submission WHERE id = #{submissionId} LIMIT 1 ) a2 ON a1.assignment_id = a2.assignment_id AND a1.subject_id = a2.subject_id AND a1.subject_type = a2.subject_type SET a1.final_score_override = #{finalScore}, a1.override_reason = #{reason}, a1.override_by_user_id = #{userId}, a1.override_at = NOW(), a1.updated_at = NOW()

UPDATE assessment_submission SET release_status = #{releaseStatus}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND session_id = #{sessionId} AND ( -- For individual assessments, update the specific student's submissions (subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND subject_id = #{subjectId} AND #{subjectType} = 'INDIVIDUAL') OR -- For group assessments, update all submissions for group members (subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND #{subjectType} = 'GROUP' AND subject_id IN ( SELECT sg.user_id FROM sys_student_group sg WHERE sg.group_id = #{subjectId} )) OR -- Also update the group-level submission if it exists (subject_type = 'GROUP' AND subject_id = #{subjectId} AND #{subjectType} = 'GROUP') )

UPDATE assessment_submission SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND session_id = #{sessionId} AND ( -- For individual assessments, update the specific student's submissions (subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND subject_id = #{subjectId} AND #{subjectType} = 'INDIVIDUAL') OR -- For group assessments, update all submissions for group members (subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND #{subjectType} = 'GROUP' AND subject_id IN ( SELECT sg.user_id FROM sys_student_group sg WHERE sg.group_id = #{subjectId} )) OR -- Also update the group-level submission if it exists (subject_type = 'GROUP' AND subject_id = #{subjectId} AND #{subjectType} = 'GROUP') )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' THEN asub.subject_id WHEN asub.subject_type = 'GROUP' THEN sg.user_id ELSE NULL END ) as student_count FROM assessment_submission asub LEFT JOIN sys_student_group sg ON asub.subject_type = 'GROUP' AND asub.subject_id = sg.group_id WHERE asub.assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND asub.session_id = #{sessionId} AND ( -- For individual assessments, count the specific student (asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND asub.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND #{subjectType} = 'INDIVIDUAL') OR -- For group assessments, count all group members (asub.subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND #{subjectType} = 'GROUP' AND asub.subject_id IN ( SELECT sg2.user_id FROM sys_student_group sg2 WHERE sg2.group_id = #{subjectId} )) OR -- For group-level submissions, count all group members (asub.subject_type = 'GROUP' AND asub.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND #{subjectType} = 'GROUP') )
